summary.text: Edmond Laplante is the Constitution Party nominee for the open New Hampshire U.S. Senate seat. He is a Marine Corps veteran and longtime automotive mechanic who, in his Ballotpedia survey response, lists himself as New Hampshire state chairman of the Constitution Party and a member of the SAU93 (Richmond) school board.

paragraphs.text: Born in Gardner, Massachusetts; earned a high school diploma from Montachusett Regional Vocational Tech and graduated from the Ohio Diesel and Gas Technical Institute in 1988.
Served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1999 to 2007.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey response, describes himself as an auto mechanic for more than 40 years, with a "master tech degree," an associate degree in aviation science and an A&P license.

Is New Hampshire state chairman of the Constitution Party and a member of the SAU93 (Richmond) school board, according to his survey response; Ballotpedia notes a past affiliation with the Richmond Swanzey Republican Town Committee.
